name: pdfsimpli.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 304 images have no alt attribute.
lesson: Describe what each image shows in its alt attribute, and use alt="" on purely decorative ones.
summary: pdfsimpli.com scores 74 out of 100 (C). 3 checks fail now, 24 are at risk, and 36 pass. Fix first: 23 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 23 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /pdf-editor/, /pdf-converter/, /translate/ and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: A cookie banner was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Microsoft Ads (11 requests), Google Ads (2 requests), Google Analytics (2 requests), and cookies _gcl_au, _uetsid, _uetvid, MUID on bing.com, _ga_PJ1Z0WB01N, _ga.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: 304 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 124 elements on /, /pdf-editor/, /pdf-converter/, for example #Login2_link > span and #bulletContent1. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: 2 cookies are sent without Secure, and 1 session cookie is readable by scripts
fix.evidence: Without Secure: service_token, redis_fetch. Without HttpOnly: service_token. A script injected into the page could steal the session. Set on /, /pdf-editor/, /pdf-converter/ and 17 more.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page arrived in 142 ms
Every page has a meta description
